page.overview:
Who is Othuyeg?

Othuyeg is an entity that appears as a great tentacled eye similar to Cyäegha, but much more similar to the monster featured in the horror movie The Crawling Eye. He currently dwells within the subsoil of Kansas, in the fabled Seven Cities of Gold.

Othuyeg has as its servitor species miniature versions of itself known simply as the Spawn of Othuyeg. Since there is also a Mate of Othuyeg the Spawn may literally be its children.

Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Other Supernatural Beings
